answer: Duplicate identities can't reuse the same asset, so a sybil attacker must acquire and lock real, independently verifiable assets per identity, making mass fake accounts economically prohibitive. Require each agent reputation slot to stake a unique physical asset token, such as a registered orchard plot, an onyx provenance certificate, or a timber harvest license, verified against a public registry. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
